name: DownloadFromWebNode
label: Download from Web
description: Downloads text or a file from the web and stores it in memory or saves it to a file.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: Url
fields.label: URL
fields.description: The URL of the resource to download (e.g., text, HTML, JSON, PDF).

fields.name: SaveToFile
fields.label: Save To File
fields.description: If true, downloads and saves the content to a local file instead of returning as string.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: Full path where the downloaded file should be saved. Required if 'Save To File' is true.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait before failing due to timeout.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the downloaded content as string or file path depending on mode.
